newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Fortis has no comment on possible CIC bid.
newsitem.headline: Fortis has no comment on possible CIC bid.

text.p: Dutch-Belgian financial group Fortis declined on Thursday to comment on reports that it was no longer in the race to buy a big stake in French Credit Industriel et Commercial (CIC).
"We never talk about possible acquisitions," a Fortis spokesman said, after Dutch press agency ANP reported the Dutch-Belgian group had not bid for CIC.
The French government launched a tender on August 6 for the sale of 67 percent of CIC. The tender closed last Monday on October 7.
Fortis had been mentioned as a possible candidate.
ANP said Fortis, which signed a letter of intent to buy Dutch investment bank MeesPierson last Friday, had been one of seven possible bidders for CIC.
It is not yet known how much Fortis is willing to pay for MeesPierson but analysts estimate a price of 2.0 to 2.5 billion guilders.
